title: Design system reskin — update AlcheColors, AlcheTypography, AlcheRadii, all components
description: Full design system audit and reskin. Update AlcheColors (light + dark mode palettes), AlcheTypography (Cormorant Garamond display, Outfit body — verify weights, sizes, line heights), AlcheRadii (sm/md/lg values), AlcheSpacing (xs through xl). Update all reusable components: AlcheCard, AlcheButton, AlcheTag, AlcheEmptyStateView, DataSourceIndicator. Ensure every token supports adaptive light/dark rendering. Verify Color.alcheBackground and Color.alcheSurface are used consistently — no static Color.cream or Color.linen anywhere. This unblocks TASK-002.

title: Update all 77 feature views to new design system tokens
description: After design system reskin, sweep all 77 feature views across Features/ to ensure: (1) no hardcoded colors remain, (2) no system fonts (.body, .caption, .subheadline) remain, (3) all backgrounds use Color.alcheBackground or Color.alcheSurface, (4) all cards use AlcheCard, (5) all buttons use AlcheButton, (6) all spacing uses AlcheSpacing tokens. Cover: Auth, Onboarding, Home, Booking, Shop, InStore, Discover, Profile, GlowScan, Biomarkers, Protocols, Progress, DigitalTwin, Nutrition, Restaurants, DoctorSessions.

title: Phase 5 testing — XCTest for all service layers
description: Write XCTest suites for every service protocol. Cover: BookingServiceProtocol, SmoothieServiceProtocol, EventServiceProtocol, ShopServiceProtocol, ProtocolServiceProtocol, ProgressServiceProtocol, GlowScanServiceProtocol, BiomarkerServiceProtocol, DigitalTwinServiceProtocol, RestaurantServiceProtocol, NutritionTrackingServiceProtocol, DoctorSessionServiceProtocol, ReferralServiceProtocol, NotificationServiceProtocol. Each test file: test load/fetch, test create/update/delete, test error states, test edge cases (empty data, maximum values). Also write XCUITest for critical flows: onboarding, booking an LED session, ordering a smoothie, logging a meal, booking a doctor session.

title: Accessibility pass — VoiceOver, Dynamic Type, contrast
description: Full accessibility audit across all 23 features. (1) VoiceOver: add accessibilityLabel and accessibilityHint to all interactive elements, ensure logical reading order, test with VoiceOver on device. (2) Dynamic Type: verify all text scales with preferredContentSizeCategory, test with largest accessibility size. (3) Contrast: verify all text/background combinations meet WCAG AA (4.5:1 for body, 3:1 for large text). (4) Tap targets: all interactive elements minimum 44x44pt. (5) Reduce Motion: respect accessibilityReduceMotion for all animations. (6) Button labels: no icon-only buttons without accessibilityLabel.

title: Localization — EN + DE string catalogs
description: Extract all user-facing strings into String Catalogs (.xcstrings). EN as source language, DE as first translation. Cover: all button labels, all section headers, all error messages, all empty state messages, all onboarding copy, all health disclaimers, all notification copy. Use Xcode 15+ String Catalog format. Verify all strings use LocalizedStringKey in SwiftUI views. Special attention: health/wellness language must be accurate in German (wellness practitioner = Wellness-Berater, not Arzt). Nutrition disclaimers must be legally accurate in German.
